report.summary: During the window, the total review count was 3149 with a positive share of 28.23 percent, compared to the baseline positive share of 34.12 percent across 15072 reviews from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-28. Content mentions in negative reviews reached 30.97 percent, and platform policy negative mentions constituted 25.27 percent of negative reviews. There were 0 sale days and 0 discount days, and off-topic negative review share was 0.35 percent. Players with more than 200 hours accounted for 51.13 percent of reviews, while players with less than 2 hours made up 0.54 percent. A price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and noise or seasonality are ruled out. The patch and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive.
